purpose: 解释器、包来源、pip / pytest 版本、激活文件、工作区初态
cmd: id; echo VIRTUAL_ENV=$VIRTUAL_ENV; echo RH2_BASHENV_WRITE=$( ( : >> /rh2/bash_env ) 2>/dev/null && echo WRITABLE || echo DENIED ); python -c 'import sys; print("RH2_SYS_EXECUTABLE="+sys.executable)'; python -c 'import numpy, Orange; import Orange.preprocess._discretize as d; print("Orange", Orange.__file__, "numpy", numpy.__version__, "ext", d.__file__)'; command -v xvfb-run gcc cc; python -m pip --version 2>&1 | head -1; python -m pytest --version 2>&1 | head -1; git status --porcelain=v1; echo PORCELAIN_RC=$?

purpose: 以 agent 身份只改 _discretize.pyx（与评分候选 C2 相同的两处替换）
cmd:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path("Orange/preprocess/_discretize.pyx"); s = p.read_text()
a = "        return [(v1+v2)/2 for v1,v2 in zip(dist[0], dist[0][1:])]\n"
b = "                inone = N/toGo\n    return points\n"
assert s.count(a) == 1 and s.count(b) == 1
s = s.replace(a, "        return sorted(set([(v1+v2)/2 for v1,v2 in zip(dist[0], dist[0][1:])]))\n")
s = s.replace(b, "                inone = N/toGo\n    return sorted(set(points))\n")
p.write_text(s); print("EDITED")
PY

purpose: agent 身份下编译扩展要用的 sysconfig 路径与可访问性
cmd: python -c "import sysconfig as s; print('LIBDIR', s.get_config_var('LIBDIR')); print('LDLIBRARY', s.get_config_var('LDLIBRARY')); print('BLDLIBRARY', s.get_config_var('BLDLIBRARY'))"; ls -ld /root 2>&1; ls -ld /root/.local/share/uv/python/cpython-3.7.9-linux-x86_64-gnu/lib 2>&1; ls /opt/py/cpython-3.7.9-linux-x86_64-gnu/lib 2>&1 | grep -i libpython
